dial.summary: 5/8 indicators supportive entering November 9 — real yields at 2.60% (DFII10 Nov 5) continue their 4-week descent and the Fed balance sheet holds flat near $6.75T, while DXY at 102.30 (Friday Nov 6 close, trading subdued at ~102.20 in Asian session Nov 9 per FXStreet) remains the lone Tier 1 headwind; October CPI releases tomorrow (Nov 10) as the decisive catalyst for the December FOMC decision; BTC.D at ~59.3% and TOTAL at ~$2.60T are consistent with an accumulation phase with no alt-rotation signal yet.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) holds at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317B); October G4 data not yet published — MacroMicro typically updates mid-month following the reference month, so October G4 update expected mid-November 2026; US M2 at $23.41T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY, next US M2 release November 24) confirms no YoY contraction; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%) exceeds flat threshold — trend UP; Bitrue broader global estimate ~$103.66T; status supportive (4-week trend up); held unchanged from Nov 8 run — October G4 data publication pending mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, 2026), beating consensus 54.6%, up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive expansion month; Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Prices 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next ISM Manufacturing release December 1, 2026 (November data); value confirmed November 9 — monthly series, October 55.5 is the current reading.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot 102.298 as of Friday November 6, 2026 close (Trading Economics); FXStreet reports DXY 'remains subdued' at ~102.20 during Asian session November 9, as lower oil prices ease inflation pressure ahead of October CPI release November 10; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.5–101.8 range (Oct 5–7) to 102.30 (Nov 6), net change approximately +0.5–0.8% exceeds the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (DXY above 100 — must fall below 97.5 for supportive); FRED DTWEXBGS unavailable via direct API in this environment (network restriction); prior 52-week high 102.95 (Oct 14, 2026).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.60% on November 5, 2026 (dollarliquidity.com sourced from FRED DFII10; Nov 4 was 2.64%, Nov 3 was 2.65%, Nov 2 was 2.62%); Nov 7 close unavailable due to FRED API network restriction in this environment; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~2.92% on October 2 (macroradar.io) to 2.60% on November 5, approximately -32bps; status supportive (falling trend — the headwind rule requires rising AND above 2% simultaneously, only one condition met); next DFII10 update will reflect Nov 7 Friday close.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread confirmed at +35bps as of November 6, 2026 close (10Y: 4.86%, 2Y: 4.51% per ETF Trends; FRED T10Y2Y: 0.35%, yieldcurve.pro: +35bps); down 3bps on the day from +38bps on Nov 5 as NFP beat bear-flattened the front end; 4-week trend FLAT — from approximately +30–32bps around October 7 (recovering off Sep low of ~20bps) to +35bps on November 6, approximately +3–5bps within the flat threshold; 52-week range 20–74bps; status neutral (positive and recovering but not sustainably steepening on a 4-week basis).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,748,145M ($6.748T) for week ended November 4, 2026 (FRED updated November 5; next H.4.1 release November 12 for week ended November 11); prior readings: Oct 28 $6,745,635M, Oct 21 $6,753,604M, Oct 14 $6,755,639M; 4-week change Oct 7 → Nov 4: balance sheet oscillating in a narrow ~$10B band, essentially flat; balance sheet stabilized post-QT-pause (QT ended December 2025); YoY +2.4% from ~$6.59T; status supportive (flat, no aggressive QT, overnight rates stable); FRED API network-restricted — latest WALCL value sourced from prior confirmed FRED data and websearch corroboration.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass unavailable (network restriction); latest available DeFi Rate snapshots from October 20–22, 2026 show OI-weighted BTC perp funding ~+8.8% annualized (≈0.0080% per 8h), consistent with the 0.0087% from the November 8 CoinGlass read; 30-day average through Oct 20 was ~+5.2% annualized (≈0.0048% per 8h); range oscillating 0.005–0.010% per 8h over 30 days — trend FLAT; late-September rates were near zero/negative (OKX -2.0% annualized Sep 26); status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold); value held from Nov 8 — coinglass.com needs to be allowed in network settings for live refresh.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap confirmed ~$286–295B as of November 5, 2026 (stablecoin.com: $286.3B; The Central Bulletin via DefiLlama: $295.21B); total crypto market cap ~$2.60T (BTC dominance ~59.3% per TV-Hub); implied stablecoin dominance ~$290B/$2.60T ≈ 11.2% (unchanged from Nov 8); 30-day trend UP — October 1 dominance ~10.2% ($291B/$2.86T), now 11.2% as TOTAL fell while stablecoins held; status neutral — headwind requires rising dominance AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL is well below Oct 1 level ($2.60T vs $2.86T) so headwind condition not met, but dominance is not falling so supportive condition not met either.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 8, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims released Wednesday November 12 (shifted one day earlier from normal Thursday due to Veterans Day federal holiday November 11); first labor pulse following the strong October NFP (+165K, unemployment 4.1%); a print below 215K would reinforce December hike odds; a spike above 230K would re-open debate about labor-market cooling ahead of the FOMC blackout period (November 28); Fed H.4.1 balance sheet release (WALCL, week ended Nov 11) also expected this day.

upcoming.title: PPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Producer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — consensus: +0.3% MoM headline and core; September PPI was 6.3% YoY and ISM Manufacturing Prices remains at 75.2 (9th consecutive above 70), signaling persistent upstream cost pressure; completes the November inflation picture alongside CPI (Nov 10) and provides the final inflation input set for the December FOMC dot plot revision.

upcoming.title: US Retail Sales (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases October 2026 Advance Monthly Retail Trade Survey at 8:30 AM ET; September retail sales were +0.8% MoM (well above the +0.3% forecast); consumer spending pulse following the October 30 crypto crash (~$1.49B liquidations), elevated energy prices, Iran war uncertainty, and post-midterm fiscal recalibration; a print above +0.5% MoM would support December hiking odds; a miss near 0% would add soft-landing ambiguity.

upcoming.title: Industrial Production (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases October 2026 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization (G.17) at 9:15 AM ET; September industrial production rose +0.4% MoM driven by manufacturing and utilities; a continued expansion would corroborate the ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5 (October) and support the view that the goods sector is broadening the recovery; note: the Fed is also planning an annual G.17 revision release on November 24.
